title: 秋華賞の後に・変わったのは

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I got the result I wanted at the Shuka Sho! I'm happy I can share that news with you guys, but… it wasn't a dazzling performance by any stretch.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be a dazzling city girl that everyone would cheer for from the bottom of their hearts… but all they wanted to see was "Yukino Bijin the Country Bumpkin."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: …Would they still like me if I gave up on becoming a city girl and just stayed the cutesy Snow Angel?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: …Whoa, this letter got kinda gloomy, huh? I don't think I'm gonna be sending this letter…
